local_backend_policy.clock: LOCAL wall-clock epoch seconds, strictly next multiple of300; UTC/KST five-minute boundaries align; not L1J sixfold clock; once reserved, convert wall departure/arrival to world.runtime.clock monotonic deadlines; reconnect within runtime preserves those deadlines; no NTP-induced leg duration drift
local_backend_policy.boarding_window: LOCAL inclusive native dock Box; 4EF8 key4 reserves the next departure while player remains at dock; duplicate input preserves deadline; disconnect before departure cancels reservation
local_backend_policy.departure: At next native key4 five-minute schedule time relocate to native map83 Point(32735,32797); f3/f4=2/2 are preserved raw and not interpreted as durations
local_backend_policy.arrival: At subsequent schedule time relocate to map70; LOCAL uniform random choice among actual standable cells of native RandomPoint radius box x/y +/-7; missing terrain refuses before boarding
local_backend_policy.consumption: Boarding and departure check native12017 possession; successful disembark debits one owned12017 with core CAS, following L1J C_Ship.java:63-64 map83 consume policy; native and L1J40300 namespaces remain separate
local_backend_policy.failure_order: Existing position+inventory APIs are separate commits. Relocate first, then debit, then publish. Failed relocation never debits; ambiguous debit is terminal and never retried. Not a crash-atomic joint transaction; crash between relocation and debit can leave a free arrival
local_backend_policy.reconnect: Cancel/join feature task at disconnect. In-process map83 reconnect retains absolute arrival deadline; overdue arrival runs after selection under row/world lock. Restart without feature memory uses saved map83 and next schedule boundary, rechecking ticket. Map70 never launches another debit
local_backend_policy.return_scroll: LOCAL destination native key4 f12 map4(33426,33502), heading4; item owner validates terrain, consumes and saves; external relocation cancels voyage
